name: Dense fused attention (FlashAttention-2, PyTorch SDPA)
q1_graph: Complete graph over tokens/nodes; QK^T scores and AV mixing fused in one IO-aware kernel
q3_topology_at_inference: Soft weights change per input; structure fixed (complete)
q6_training: Exact attention, standard backprop; backward recomputes scores
q7_scaling: Quadratic FLOPs in N; cheap at small N (hundreds of nodes)
q11_gpu: Up to 73% of A100 peak; 3-10x faster than unfused attention; native PyTorch SDPA/Triton
q13_best_results: GPT-2 3x and BERT 15% end-to-end speedup vs unfused at identical FLOPs
q14_unexplored: Wall-clock of dense attention vs gather/scatter graph at our N (<=1k) and matched FLOPs: not found

name: FlexAttention block-masked attention (mask_mod/score_mod, BlockMask)
q1_graph: Attention restricted by a user mask over a complete graph; skips fully masked 128x128 tiles
q2_edges: Mask can be any function, incl. a learned top-k adjacency
q3_topology_at_inference: Mask changes need no recompile but BlockMask must be rebuilt (expensive)
q7_scaling: Saves work only at tile granularity; N<=128 gives one tile (no savings)
q11_gpu: 0.68-1.43x FA2 (paper); 90%/85% fwd/bwd of FA2 (blog); default BLOCK_SIZE 128
q12_repos: PyTorch core (GitHub licence NOASSERTION); meta-pytorch/attention-gym BSD-3-Clause
q13_best_results: 2.4x training speedup in torchtune; 2.04x gpt-fast inference at 16k
q14_unexplored: Cost of rebuilding a learned BlockMask every recurrent iteration at N=100-1000: not found

name: Gather/scatter message passing (PyG + torch_scatter, DGL g-SpMM)
q1_graph: Edge-list gather of source states, per-edge message, scatter-reduce into targets
q2_edges: Given edge_index; learned edges require building edge_index each step
q3_topology_at_inference: Possible if edge_index recomputed per iteration (dynamic E breaks static shapes)
q6_training: Standard autograd; scatter backward is gather
q7_scaling: Linear in edges; aggregation dominates large-graph training (>83.6% SpMM)
q8_stability: Atomic scatter is nondeterministic on CUDA
q11_gpu: Aggregation memory-bound: L2 hit 6.87%, 2.35 DRAM bytes/op vs 0.01 for dense combination; small graphs overhead-bound; torch.compile needs static shapes
q12_repos: rusty1s/pytorch_scatter MIT, last push 2026-06 (PyG/DGL repo facts in R1 ledger)
q13_best_results: Aggregation profile only; no FLOP-matched win over dense attention found
q14_unexplored: Recurrent T-step gather/scatter with per-step learned edges, profiled against looped dense attention: not found

name: JAX segment_sum message passing (jraph-style)
q2_edges: Given segment ids; learned edges need fixed-size padding
q3_topology_at_inference: Only with static num_segments and padded edge count under jit
q6_training: Autodiff; lax.while_loop not reverse-differentiable (use scan with T_max)
q11_gpu: Static shapes required under jit; sorted-index hints available
q12_repos: unknown (jraph repo facts are in R1 ledger, not R5)
q14_unexplored: Learned halting in JAX without fixed T_max unroll: not found

name: Unstructured sparse kernels (SpMM/SDDMM: Sputnik, cuSPARSE, torch.sparse)
q1_graph: Sparse matrix x dense matrix (aggregation) and sampled dense-dense (edge scores)
q3_topology_at_inference: Pattern can change but formats must be rebuilt
q7_scaling: Pays off mainly at very high or structured sparsity
q11_gpu: Best kernels reach 27% of FP32 peak; library kernels lose to dense at DNN sparsity levels
q13_best_results: 3.58x SpMM over cuSPARSE; 1.2-2.1x end-to-end sparse Transformer vs dense at matched accuracy
q14_unexplored: Break-even sparsity vs dense tensor-core attention at N<=1k, recomputed every iteration: not found

name: Trainable block-sparse top-k attention (NSA)
q1_graph: Per-query selection of top-k KV blocks plus compressed and sliding branches
q6_training: End-to-end trainable; discrete selection needs a gradient path
q7_scaling: Speedup grows with length: 9.0x fwd / 6.0x bwd at 64k
q11_gpu: Blockwise selection for tensor cores; token-granular selection blocks FlashAttention-style kernels
q12_repos: fla-org/native-sparse-attention MIT (third-party Triton, not DeepSeek official)
q13_best_results: Up to 9.0x forward over Triton FA2 at 64k context
q14_unexplored: Node-level (graph) analogue with blocks of nodes at N<=1k: not found
